        🔌 14. Database Connector — Enterprise Database Connectors & Integrations Studio

        Production-grade, bi-directional connectivity for Relational Databases, NoSQL, Cloud Data Warehouses, SaaS Spreadsheets, APIs, and Cloud Object Storage lakes with defense-in-depth credential encryption.

        🛡️ AES-256 Vault 🔒 Zero Plaintext ⚡ 12 Drivers
        🏛️ Enterprise Database Connections Architecture & Security Blueprints Production Ready
        🛡️ Fernet AES-256 ⚡ 7 Core DBs 🔒 Zero Plaintext

        Production-grade connection topologies, connection pooling, high-throughput streaming, and defense-in-depth credential handling across all 7 enterprise database engines. Select any database to view its deep architectural specification:

        🔌 Protocol & Driver Stack
        • Driver: psycopg2-binary / SQLAlchemy 2.0
        • Wire Protocol: PostgreSQL Frontend/Backend Protocol v3.0
        • Default Port: 5432 (TCP)
        • Character Encoding: UTF-8 Client Encoding
        🔄 Connection Pooling & Lifecycle
        • Pool Manager: Thread-safe QueuePool (size: 10, max overflow: 20)
        • Pool Recycle: 1,800s to eliminate stale firewall sockets
        • Liveness Health Probe: SELECT 1 pre-ping on checkout
        • Connection Timeout: 10s socket connect timeout
        🛡️ Security & Credential Handling
        • Encryption at Rest: Fernet AES-256 symmetric cipher via PBKDF2
        • Transport Encryption: Enforced TLS (sslmode=require / verify-full)
        • Authentication: SCRAM-SHA-256 SASL authentication
        • Sanitization: postgresql://user:********@host:5432/db in all telemetry
        ⚡ Streaming & Memory Architecture
        • Server-Side Cursors: declare_first named cursors prevent client OOM
        • Batch Chunking: Streamed in 5,000-row records directly into Pandas
        • Schema Introspection: information_schema.columns & primary key catalog
        • Zero-Copy Handover: Direct Arrow record batch streaming
        # PostgreSQL Architecture Connection Pattern
        from modules.connectors import create_connector, ConnectorConfig, ConnectorType
        cfg = ConnectorConfig(connector_type=ConnectorType.POSTGRESQL, host="db.prod.internal", port=5432, database="analytics_prod", username="analyst", ssl_enabled=True)
        conn = create_connector(cfg)
        conn.set_credential("vault_encrypted_master_secret") # Decrypted only ephemerally in socket factory
        schema = conn.get_schema() # Introspects tables, types, and column nullability
        df = conn.execute_query("SELECT * FROM customers LIMIT 1000")
        🔌 Protocol & Driver Stack
        • Driver: pymysql / mysql-connector-python
        • Wire Protocol: MySQL Client/Server Binary Protocol
        • Default Port: 3306 (TCP)
        • Collation / Charset: utf8mb4_unicode_ci full 4-byte emoji support
        🔄 Connection Pooling & Lifecycle
        • Thread Pooling: Dedicated connection pool (pool size: 10)
        • Keep-Alive Pings: Automatic connection validation before execution
        • Auto-Reconnect: Graceful reconnection on server idle disconnects
        • Locking: Read-committed isolation level for analytical queries
        🛡️ Security & Credential Handling
        • Authentication: caching_sha2_password / native SHA-256
        • Transport Encryption: TLS 1.2/1.3 with cipher suite restriction
        • Zero-Plaintext Vault: AES-256 encrypted credential state
        • Telemetry Scrubber: Regex redaction of host & credentials in logs
        ⚡ Streaming & Memory Architecture
        • Unbuffered Cursor: SSCursor (Server-Side Cursor) for large extractions
        • Memory Safety: Row-by-row TCP window streaming to prevent RAM spikes
        • Schema Introspection: information_schema.TABLES & COLUMNS
        • Type Mapping: Decimal to float64, DATETIME to Pandas Timestamp
        # MySQL Connection & Secure Ingestion
        cfg = ConnectorConfig(connector_type=ConnectorType.MYSQL, host="mysql.cluster.internal", port=3306, database="ecommerce_store", username="db_reader")
        conn = create_connector(cfg)
        conn.set_credential("vault_encrypted_password")
        res = conn.test_connection() # Returns latency_ms and MySQL server version
        🔌 Protocol & Driver Stack
        • Driver: Standard Python sqlite3 (Zero External Dependencies)
        • Engine: In-Process C-Engine with direct virtual table architecture
        • Storage Mode: Disk file or :memory: transient cache
        • Zero Network Overhead: Zero TCP/IP roundtrips, sub-millisecond execution
        🔄 Concurrency & WAL Performance
        • Journal Mode: PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; (Write-Ahead Logging)
        • Concurrency: Non-blocking concurrent readers during write transactions
        • Cache Optimization: PRAGMA cache_size = -64000; (64MB memory page cache)
        • Synchronous Flag: PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL; for high IOPS
        🛡️ Security & Path Sandboxing
        • Path Sandboxing: Strict validation forbidding directory traversal (..)
        • OS ACLs: Inherited filesystem read permissions on database files
        • SQL Injection Defense: Parameterized query bindings across all methods
        • Pre-Seeded Demo DB: Auto-provisions sample_data/enterprise_demo.db
        ⚡ Streaming & Memory Architecture
        • Zero-Copy Ingestion: pd.read_sql_query() with C-level record deserialization
        • Chunksize Batching: Generator-based pagination for large SQLite databases
        • Schema Introspection: sqlite_master and PRAGMA table_info()
        • Views & Indexes: Introspects both materialized tables and SQL views
        # SQLite Path-Sandboxed Connector
        from modules.connectors.demo_db import get_or_create_demo_sqlite
        db_path, _ = get_or_create_demo_sqlite()
        cfg = ConnectorConfig(connector_type=ConnectorType.SQLITE, database=db_path)
        conn = create_connector(cfg)
        df = conn.execute_query("SELECT * FROM v_customer_revenue")
        🔌 Protocol & Driver Stack
        • Driver: Microsoft ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server / pyodbc
        • Wire Protocol: TDS (Tabular Data Stream) Protocol v7.4+
        • Default Port: 1433 (TCP)
        • Wire Encryption: Encrypt=yes;TrustServerCertificate=no;
        🔄 Connection Pooling & Lifecycle
        • Pooling: ODBC driver-managed connection pooling
        • Failover: MultiSubnetFailover support for SQL Server Always-On AG
        • Timeout Controls: Connection Timeout=30;Login Timeout=15;
        • Application Name: Tagged as Application Name=DataMindAI
        🛡️ Security & Credential Handling
        • Auth Modes: SQL Server Authentication & Windows Integrated (Kerberos)
        • Azure Entra ID: ActiveDirectoryPassword / Managed Identity tokens
        • Vault Encryption: Passwords encrypted with Fernet AES-256
        • Zero-Plaintext: Redaction of connection string parameters in tracebacks
        ⚡ Streaming & Memory Architecture
        • Fast Executemany: cursor.fast_executemany = True for batching
        • Cursor Batching: fetchmany(5000) pagination across TDS stream
        • Schema Introspection: Queries sys.tables, sys.columns, sys.schemas
        • Data Types: Full support for NVARCHAR(MAX), MONEY, and DATETIMEOFFSET
        # MS SQL Server Encrypted TDS Connector
        cfg = ConnectorConfig(connector_type=ConnectorType.MSSQL, host="sqlserver.corp.local", port=1433, database="CorpWarehouse", username="sa", ssl_enabled=True)
        conn = create_connector(cfg)
        conn.set_credential("vault_encrypted_sa_pwd")
        df = conn.execute_query("SELECT TOP 100 * FROM FactSales")
        🔌 Protocol & Driver Stack
        • Driver: Official pymongo with dnspython SRV resolver
        • Protocol: MongoDB Wire Protocol (OP_MSG)
        • Connection String: Standard or Atlas SRV (mongodb+srv://)
        • Default Port: 27017 (TCP)
        🔄 Connection Pooling & Sharding
        • Client Pooling: MongoClient pool (maxPoolSize=50, minPoolSize=5)
        • Topology Discovery: Automatic replica set primary/secondary detection
        • Read Preference: secondaryPreferred for analytical extractions
        • Server Selection Timeout: 5,000 ms fail-fast threshold
        🛡️ Security & Credential Handling
        • Authentication: SCRAM-SHA-256, MONGODB-AWS (IAM), or X.509 certificates
        • TLS / SNI: TLS 1.3 enforced for all MongoDB Atlas clusters
        • Vault Storage: Encrypted connection tokens in Fernet AES-256 vault
        • Sanitizer: Regex masking of mongodb+srv://user:pass@host
        ⚡ Streaming & BSON Flattening
        • Tabular Normalization: flatten_mongo_documents() flattens nested BSON
        • ObjectId Casting: Converts _id (ObjectId) to string identifiers
        • Schema Sampling: Samples 100 documents to infer tabular schema & types
        • Aggregation Pipelines: Native JSON aggregation query execution
        # MongoDB Document to Tabular DataFrame Flattening
        cfg = ConnectorConfig(connector_type=ConnectorType.MONGODB, host="cluster0.mongodb.net", database="analytics_lake")
        conn = create_connector(cfg)
        conn.set_credential("vault_encrypted_atlas_token")
        df = conn.execute_query('{"collection": "user_sessions", "filter": {"duration_sec": {"$gt": 100}}}')
        🔌 Protocol & Driver Stack
        • Driver: snowflake-connector-python with PyArrow extensions
        • Protocol: Snowflake REST / Arrow Flight Columnar Wire Protocol
        • Endpoint: account.region.snowflakecomputing.com:443 (HTTPS)
        • Multi-Cluster Architecture: Separated compute & centralized cloud storage
        🔄 Virtual Warehouse Management
        • Elastic Scaling: Connects to specified warehouse (e.g. COMPUTE_WH)
        • Auto-Suspend / Resume: Zero cost during idle query intervals
        • Session Context: Sets ROLE, WAREHOUSE, DATABASE, SCHEMA
        • Query Tagging: Queries tagged with QUERY_TAG='DataMindAI'
        🛡️ Security & Credential Handling
        • Auth Modes: Key-Pair (RSA 2048-bit private key), Okta/Azure SSO, or OAuth2
        • Private Key Encryption: PKCS#8 encrypted with passphrase in Fernet vault
        • Zero Plaintext: Keys never written unencrypted to disk or config files
        • Redaction: Sanitizer strips Snowflake account tokens and JWT signatures
        ⚡ Sub-Second Arrow Flight Streaming
        • Zero-Copy Memory: cursor.fetch_pandas_all() via Apache Arrow Flight
        • Throughput: 10x faster than traditional CSV/ODBC serialization
        • Schema Introspection: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS query
        • Partition Pruning: Pushes filter predicates down to micro-partitions
        # Snowflake Arrow Flight Zero-Copy Connector
        cfg = ConnectorConfig(connector_type=ConnectorType.SNOWFLAKE, host="xy12345.us-east-1", database="ANALYTICS", username="BI_ENGINEER", extra_params={"warehouse": "COMPUTE_WH"})
        conn = create_connector(cfg)
        conn.set_credential("vault_encrypted_rsa_key_block")
        df = conn.execute_query("SELECT * FROM FCT_DAILY_ORDERS LIMIT 5000")
        🔌 Protocol & Driver Stack
        • Driver: google-cloud-bigquery with google-cloud-bigquery-storage
        • Protocol: BigQuery REST API v2 & High-Speed gRPC Storage Read API
        • Architecture: Serverless distributed query execution (Dremel + Colossus)
        • Format: Columnar Capacitor file format on Google infrastructure
        💰 Pre-Flight Cost Estimator & Dry Run
        • Dry Run Verification: job_config.dry_run = True estimates bytes billed
        • Cost Protection: Calculates estimated USD cost before running execution
        • Maximum Billed Limit: Configurable maximum_bytes_billed cap
        • Partition & Cluster Filtering: Validates partition filter predicates
        🛡️ Security & Credential Handling
        • Auth Modes: Google IAM Service Account JSON key or Workload Identity
        • Vault Encryption: Full service account JSON encrypted in Fernet AES-256
        • OAuth2 Token Scopes: Restricted strictly to BigQuery read-only scopes
        • Redaction: Sanitizer masks client email, private key ID, and project IDs
        ⚡ BigQuery Storage Read API (gRPC)
        • gRPC Parallel Streaming: Streams data across partitioned gRPC channels
        • Arrow Serialization: Zero-copy Apache Arrow stream directly into Pandas
        • Schema Introspection: client.list_tables() and field descriptor metadata
        • Performance: Up to 100,000,000 rows fetched in seconds
        # BigQuery Serverless Connector with Cost Estimation
        cfg = ConnectorConfig(connector_type=ConnectorType.BIGQUERY, database="gcp-analytics-prod", host="marketing_dataset")
        conn = create_connector(cfg)
        conn.set_credential("vault_encrypted_service_account_json")
        cost_info = conn.estimate_query_cost("SELECT * FROM ad_campaign_performance") # Dry run check
        df = conn.execute_query("SELECT * FROM ad_campaign_performance LIMIT 1000")
        🔐 Fernet / AES-256 Symmetric Cipher
        • Algorithm: Fernet authenticated symmetric cryptography (AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256)
        • Key Derivation: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 100,000 derivation rounds
        • Salt Generation: Cryptographically secure 16-byte random salt
        • Integrity: Tamper-proof HMAC verification before payload decryption
        ⏳ Ephemeral In-Memory Lifecycle
        • Zero Plaintext at Rest: Raw secrets are never written to disk or serialized
        • Transient Scope: Secret is decrypted strictly during connection establishment
        • Memory Cleared: Plaintext references dereferenced immediately after socket handshake
        • Environment Key Support: Supports DATAMIND_ENCRYPTION_KEY injection
        🧼 Telemetry & Log Sanitization Engine
        • CredentialSanitizer: Regex interception of all tracebacks and logs
        • URI Redaction: user:secret@host converted to user:********@host
        • Bearer Tokens: Authorization: Bearer ... masked with [REDACTED]
        • Private Keys: BEGIN PRIVATE KEY blocks scrubbed automatically
        # CredentialVault & CredentialSanitizer Implementation
        from modules.connectors.security import CredentialVault, CredentialSanitizer
        vault = CredentialVault(salt=b"enterprise_salt")
        ciphertext = vault.encrypt("super_secret_db_password_123")
        sanitized_uri = CredentialSanitizer.sanitize_uri("postgresql://analyst:super_secret_db_password_123@db.prod:5432/lake")
        # Result: "postgresql://analyst:********@db.prod:5432/lake"

        🛡️ Fernet & AES-256 Vault

        Credentials (passwords, tokens, API keys, service accounts) are encrypted at rest using Fernet symmetric cryptography (AES-128-CBC with HMAC-SHA256) derived via 100,000 PBKDF2 iterations. Plaintext is only decrypted in ephemeral scope during socket creation.

        🧼 Automatic Credential Redaction

        All application telemetry, traces, and queries run through CredentialSanitizer. Regex filters automatically mask connection strings (postgres://user:********@host), Bearer tokens, and private keys from ever reaching logs or frontend state.

        ⚡ Standard BaseConnector Lifecycle

        Subclasses implement abstract test_connection(), get_schema(), execute_query(), and stream_records(). Apache Arrow Flight zero-copy memory transfers ensure sub-second ingestion from cloud warehouses.
